text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's New Year's Day, and I've brought Winning Ticket along for our first shrine visit of the year.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I hope I can do my absolute best and work toward my goals with my trainer this year!
choice_data_list: (I hope that Ticket will continue to be happy and healthy this year.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okay, prayer's done! I'm gonna go all out and have an amazing year!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Trainer, what did you wish for?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: To win lots of races? Or to get stronger?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not wanting to lie to Ticket, I admit to my real wish.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: For me… to be happy and healthy?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sob… I'm s-so… touched…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's really kind… Sob… You made a wish… for meeee…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go say another prayer to wish for your health too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I can stop her, she rejoins the long line for a second round of prayers.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right! I made a wish for you to be healthy too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm feeling so pumped right now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You gotta give me some training to do! Running a full marathon, hauling a tire the size of a house—you name it, I'll ace it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It would be a shame to waste her enthusiasm, so I'd better come up with a suggestion…
choice_data_list: Let's go all out on relaxing!
Let's let's go all out and pull a New Year's fortune!
Let's go all out and learn a new skill!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Go all out… relaxing?! But how? Aren't we going to practice?
choice_data_list: Let's rest today and fully recover our strength!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, that makes sense! Got it! I'm gonna take a super good nap today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: First I'll sprint back to my room at top speed!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I can call her back, she dashes off toward the academy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case, I feel sure that this is going to be an important year for her.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Go all out pulling a fortune? Hah! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Great fortune, great fortune! Come ooon, great fortune!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And she winds up pulling a…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoooaaaah! I got it! I got a "great fortune"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case, I feel sure that this is going to be an important year for her!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: A new skill? Haha! Sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Only problem is… you know, um… learning? I'm… kinda not very good at that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, no! I can't say that when I just decided I'd work hard!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Okay, then first things first…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I gotta head to the bookstore and go all out finding a good reference book!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ta-DAAA! If I wanna go all out studying, I'd better use a textbook that's a teensy bit on the difficult side!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's see… "On the effects of environmental factors on Type I and Type II muscle fibers: a biome… chanical… analysis…"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yawn… So… sleepy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case, I feel sure that this is going to be an important year for her!
